result.stdout:
webority-db-migrator - shared schema runner (DbUp), SQL Server or PostgreSQL

Usage:
  webority-db-migrator --connection "<conn>" [options]

Options:
  --connection, -c <string>   Connection string (or set MIGRATOR_CONNECTION env var)
  MIGRATOR_ACCESS_TOKEN       Entra access token for Azure SQL (env var only). The connection string
                              then carries no User ID, Password or Authentication. SQL Server only.
  --provider, -p <db>         sqlserver (default) or postgres
  --db-root, -r <dir>         DB project folder with Scripts/ and/or StoredProcedures/ (default: .)
  --what-if, -w               List pending run-once scripts, run the applied-script guard below,
                              and exit. Changes nothing.
  --status                    List every run-once script with its state (applied with its UTC time,
                              pending, changed, corrected, noChecksum, fileMissing) and the stored
                              procedures that changed, and exit. Changes nothing. Exit 3 when an
                              applied script changed. With --report-json, writes the same as JSON.
  --rehearse <seconds>        Run every pending run-once script against the target in one transaction
                              that is always rolled back, each script limited to <seconds>. Writes
                              nothing and never touches the journal; scripts marked
                              -- migrator:no-transaction are skipped and named. Exit 0 when all pass,
                              1 on any failure or timeout.
  --mark-applied, -m          Baseline: record existing run-once scripts as applied WITHOUT executing
  --force, -f                 Allow --mark-applied against a DB whose journal already has entries
                              (only valid with --mark-applied)
  --timeout, -t <seconds>     Per-script command timeout (default: 600)
  --accept-checksum <name>    Accept the current content of one already-applied script (repeatable)
  --reapply-procedur
[truncated]
